name: Nikkiso Co., Ltd.
summary: Nikkiso Co., Ltd. engages in industrial, aerospace, and medical businesses worldwide. The company provides pumps and systems, such as canned motor, reciprocating, and cryogenic submerged motor pumps; cryogenic pumps and systems; metering and mixing and odorizing systems; cryogenic heat transfer devices; and cryogenic process plant; precision equipment, including water-conditioning systems for power plants; ceramic substrate production systems; 3D sintering equipment; cold isostatic press; and dryers.
